# Environments

LocoMuJoCo provides 16 embodiments: 9 humanoid robots, 3 (musculo-)skeletal human models and 4 quadrupeds. Every embodiment is an environment class that is registered under its class name and created through a [task factory](../user_guide/task_factories.md). All of them share the same interface and the same pluggable observations, rewards, control functions, terrains and domain randomization.

Each embodiment has a variant for GPU simulation, registered under the same name with the prefix `Mjx` (for example `MjxUnitreeG1`). It runs on MJX or MuJoCo Warp, see [backends](../user_guide/backends.md).

```python
import loco_mujoco

print(list(loco_mujoco.get_registered_envs()))
```

## Overview

DoF is the number of joint degrees of freedom without the six of the floating base, and actions is the dimension of the action space, both for the default arguments of the environment. The last column lists the [dataset sources](../user_guide/datasets.md) with motion capture data for the embodiment. The MJX variant of an embodiment is registered as `Mjx<registered name>`.

| Embodiment | Registered name | Type | DoF | Actions | MJX | Datasets |

| [Unitree G1](unitree_g1.md) | `UnitreeG1` | Humanoid | 23 | 23 | yes | Default, LAFAN1, AMASS |
| [Unitree H1](unitree_h1.md) | `UnitreeH1` | Humanoid | 19 | 19 | yes | Default, LAFAN1, AMASS |

| [Apollo](apollo.md) | `Apollo` | Humanoid | 32 | 32 | yes | Default, LAFAN1, AMASS |
| [Booster T1](booster_t1.md) | `BoosterT1` | Humanoid | 23 | 23 | yes | Default, LAFAN1, AMASS |

## Human models

Models of the human body: a skeleton with one torque actuator per joint, the same skeleton driven by muscles, and the high-dimensional MyoSkeleton. They are used like the robots and have the same motion capture data.

## Adding your own

A robot that is not in the list can be added from a package of your own, without changing LocoMuJoCo. [Adding a new robot](../user_guide/new_robot.md) describes the procedure, including how to make the motion capture datasets available for it.

:caption: Humanoid robots
